name: toj-ios
description: The TOJ app for iPhone: a Capacitor shell around tojcampaign.com/app with the camera, notifications and a Share extension.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/native.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=safari15 --outfile=../public/app/native.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* TOJ iPhone app native layer. Built from mobile/src/native.js (npm run bundle). Includes @capacitor/core, app, camera and push-notifications (MIT). */"
